title: K's DARK GUI
description: Simple square texture pack, but above all... DARK
body:
![shulkerbox, inventory and crafting table dark gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e1dafc3581ce7ef34650831cb4c231b6526cfa3.jpeg) # Description ![k's dark gui title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b65864666cd2fd198936974b3bb42274e6d7545.png) [](https://www.curseforge.com/members/kentapainter/projects)[](https://discord.gg/C47W2vcKX)[]() A container GUI replacement pack that hopes to match the menu to every one of Minecraft's interactable blocks. This texture pack will replace the GUI of every block like the crafting table and even each create GUI. Each new menu will take inspiration from the bedrock GUI and few texturepacks on internet.
optigui (WIP) or optifine (WIP)


![brief explanation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65b65ba34c45d7e1d9b14ccc3da9e2ad25a950d0.png)          colored shulkerboxes                 each villager professions



If you know spanish read this!
Spoiler ![default language settings selecting spanish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/226c8ef81c02bf48f601c1d2f5c45721df163bd6_0.webp)
El paquete de texturas lo hice a partir de minecraft 1.21 porque cambiaron la estructura de las texturas. Tengo una version mas antigua pero con forma de vanilla y color oscuro, no se si publicarla.

Este paquete trae compatibilidad con varios mods y cada interfaz la traduje para que no perdiera el lenguaje si tienes (español mexico) es_mx activo. Asi todo esta en el mismo idioma, traducción incluida YAY !

GUI's

I created all the base Minecraft interfaces; you can check the gallery to get an idea. - Hotbar - Icons - Achievements - Menus - Creative Inventory - All Vanilla > **Note:** This can be used for vanilla Minecraft, but it's compatible with many mods. Think about it! # Compatibility Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 through 26 is supported. Optional: Optifine or optigui (WIP) # Mod Support
Spoiler see the img ![mod list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41eb40b36a0d79b3eeb6b0786e448a5566a5a4bb_0.webp)

FAQ

Spoiler **-Why are some textures change o looks odd?**
Maybe you have Optifine or OptiGUI installed. Some textures like villagers and shulker GUI’s only work with OptiGUI and Optifine, but I changed my mind halfway through and stopped making those colorful versions, opting for a dark theme. also had problems with OptiFine while working on version 1.21.1, but I never touched it again, preferring to include mods. **-Can I add your packs to my modpack?**
Yes, you can add any of my resource packs to your Modrinth or Curseforge modpacks if you give me proper credits and add my pack as a dependent. **-Where can i post suggestions for either mod support or other things?**
I'll think about it in the future, maybe Discord. **-Something isn't working properly or I have a question.**
What can I tell you...
